'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***''[[The Daily Telegraph|The Telegraph]]'' reports [[Russia]] has captured approximately {{convert|195|mi2|km2}} and is taking around 1,000 casualties per day since the start of the [[Eastern Ukraine campaign#Second Russian winter campaign (November 2023–present)|Second Russian winter campaign]] in October 2023. *[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]], [[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
**An [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] targeting [[Aleppo International Airport]] in [[Syria]] kills 38 [[Syrian Army|Syrian soldiers]], seven [[Hezbollah]] fighters and seven Iran-backed militiamen. The incident marks the deadliest Israeli attack on Syria since 2021. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/329662/ (SOHR)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Harvard University]] removes the [[Anthropodermic bibliopegy|binding of human skin]] from the 19th-century book ''[[Destinies of the Soul|Des destinées de l'âme]]'' by [[Arsène Houssaye]], which has been kept in its library since 1934. '''International relations'''
*[[Japan–North Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]]n [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (North Korea)|foreign minister]] [[Choe Son Hui]] says that North Korea will not hold any talks with [[Japan]] on any issue, including the issue of [[North Korean abductions of Japanese citizens|Japanese abductees in North Korea]]. This follows an announcement by [[Japanese prime minister]] [[Fumio Kishida]] in which he stated his desire to meet with [[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|North Korean supreme leader]] [[Kim Jong Un]] "without any preconditions". [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/north-korea-rules-out-any-meetings-with-japanese-officials-kcna-says-2024-03-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]], [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[Russia]] [[veto]]es the continued monitoring of [[United Nations]] [[international sanctions|sanctions]] on the North Korean [[nuclear weapon]]s program. [https://apnews.com/article/un-us-north-korea-russia-sanctions-monitoring-72f8cbac116dea7c795d9a3357fc45f3 (AP)]
